newsitem.title: USA: Standard ends dividends in restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Standard ends dividends in restructuring.

text.p: Standard Commercial Corp said Tuesday that as part of its restructuring it was discontinuing its quarterly stock dividends.
A company spokesman said Standard has distributed a one percent stock dividend for the past 10 quarters.

"The recent successful equity offering has appreciably broadened our shareholder base, and, as part of our financial restructuring, the board of directors has voted to discontinue issuing quarterly stock dividends," said chief financial officer Robert Harrison. "As a result of our successful refinancing, the company is once again well capitalized and we are excited about the future."
The company today reported June 30 first quarter earnings of $1.9 million, up 22.9 percent from $1.5 million a year earlier.

Earnings per share were $0.17 on average shares outstanding of 11.1 million versus $0.15 on 9.5 million shares outstanding for the June 1996 quarter after adjusting for stock dividends. Sales decreased 3.2 percent to $300.3 million from $310.4 million.
